title: Seacoast Boat Charters
specs: Boat is a 40-foot Sara Rose with climate control and seating for six
Encounter seals, whales, porpoises, basking sharks, blue sharks, porbeagle sharks, ocean sunfish, and seabirds including Bald Eagles
No fishing experience required; instruction provided
No individual fishing license needed; covered under vessel's permits
Life jackets must be worn by children at all times; optional for adults
Boat is not wheelchair accessible due to steps; assistance may be possible with advance notice
Boat accommodates up to six passengers
All fishing charters are private to your group only

blurb: Guests enjoy private, customizable charters on the 40-foot Sara Rose, exploring coastal sights, wildlife, and fishing opportunities. The boat features a clean head, climate control, and seating for up to six passengers. Charters include sightseeing, fishing, special events, and hands-on boat handling training.
extraNote: Full refund for cancellations made at least 48 hours in advance; less than 48 hours incurs cancellation fee · Safety is top priority; charters may be rescheduled or canceled due to unsafe weather · Guests may bring their own alcohol; captain may limit consumption for safety · Tipping is appreciated but not required; customary tip is 15-20% · Safe Harbor Wentworth by the Sea Marina, look for the blue awning labeled Seacoast Boat Charters
